_schema_note: An issue is an ORDERED SELECTION WITH AN ARGUMENT. Neither the registry nor the venue records can hold that: they carry membership, not sequence, and no place for why a piece sits where it sits. This record is the bibliographic card for an issue — modelled on the heteronym identity cards, canonical, with the JSONL surface projected from it.
title: Compression Studies: What Survives, What Burns, and Who Decides
structure: OPERATIONS — coinage, AI training, total citational graphs
INFRASTRUCTURE — the vessels that carry the compressed archive
method: Works appear as HOLOGRAPHIC KERNELS linked to their independent deposits, not reproduced in full. The issue is a compression of its own founding.
rationale: Fourteen previously deposited conceptual units across nineteen DOI records, reorganised into the founding corpus of a discipline.
open: The INFRASTRUCTURE category housed the Ark, the swarm and the f.03 field because the province did not yet exist. Appearing in this issue is a publication fact, not a claim on the category.
